artifacts.summary: Identifies the unconditional-block placement (mirroring the always-rendered User-Decision Contract section, not the conditional Territory pointer) for a new wait-discipline pointer in orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, exact pointer text, and the test additions needed across the base/hard x research/plan/implement matrix.

memory_candidates.content: In orchestrate-build-dispatch.sh, every optional dispatch-file block (memory_context, lit_context, hard_contracts_block, deploy_freshness_context, the Territory pointer, prior_decisions_block) is rendered conditionally to preserve 'byte-identical when the feature is inactive.' The ONE existing exception is the trailing '## User-Decision Contract' block, which is echoed unconditionally with no surrounding if. When a task asks for an 'always-present' addition to this script's output, the User-Decision Contract block -- not the Territory pointer -- is the correct structural template to copy, even if the task description cites the Territory pointer's header-note as the naming/documentation precedent.
